caribbean.headline: Roatan Sees 21 kt Winds, 5 ft Seas and Showers
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing east-dominant swell with sustained winds near 21 kt, seas to 5.1 ft and an 8 s swell period, with 50% rain probability. I recommend mariners secure small craft and prepare for choppy conditions while nearby Nassau reports winds up to 19 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Barcelona Rain Certain, Mykonos Winds Up to 20 kt
mediterranean.paragraph: Barcelona is experiencing light winds around 9 kt, 1.5 ft seas and a dominant SSE swell at a 5 s period, with 100% rain probability today. I note Mykonos in the eastern Mediterranean has the region's highest winds near 20 kt, which could restrict small-craft operations despite generally low seas, and I will monitor for any convective intensification.
